messages:
Lina Chen: Hey team — draft of the product reveal post is up. Main asks: legal quick-check on the benchmark claim, confirm webinar CTA + HubSpot routing, and final publish window. Draft here: https://docs.google.com/... 

Gabe Ortiz: reading now. Quick note — the benchmark number needs a source link. Can we add a one-line methodology blurb? :mag:

Mia Patel: I can update CTA to gate the webinar. Proposed copy: "Register for the live demo + benchmarking webinar". Where should registrants be tagged in HubSpot? (product_interest=redwood_reveal)

Ashwin Rao: Also need the OG image and canonical slug. Prefer to publish Tue 09:00 PT if that works.

Lina Chen: thanks. OG image in drive: /assets/reveal-og.png. Slug candidate: /blog/introducing-low-latency-inference. Can we do 09:00 PT Tue? 

Priya Singh (Legal): Quick pass: the sentence "best-in-class latency" is comparative — modify to "industry-leading latency" or provide third-party benchmark citation. Otherwise OK.

Gabe Ortiz: cool. I'll add the methodology line: "Measured p50 token latency on 8k context across n=1000 requests on our dedicated infra (see appendix)." Also added source link to benchmark notebook.

Mia Patel: HubSpot mapping CSV (preview):
```
email,first_name,last_name,product_interest,utm_source,utm_campaign
{email},{first},{last},redwood_reveal,blog,reveal_launch
```
I'll wire up the form to tag product_interest=redwood_reveal and set lead lifecycle to MQL for webinar registrants.

Ashwin Rao: CTA placement — end of post + floating banner. Can we also add a note for webinar registrants: "You will receive a calendar invite"? helps conversion.

Lina Chen: done — added calendar line. Also: please use `utm_campaign=reveal_launch_v1` in social posts vs. blog links.

Gabe Ortiz: small editorial: reword intro paragraph to focus on cost/latency tradeoff. making a PR to the doc now.

Priya Singh (Legal): Approved with edit suggestion applied. No legal holds. :white_check_mark:

marketing-bot: Publish scheduled: Tue 09:00 PT. Reminder set for 48h pre-publish send to #marketing.

Mia Patel: I'll create the HubSpot form and share the embed script here before EOD.

Ashwin Rao: LGTM. If no other blockers, I'll queue the publish and set the banner.

Lina Chen: final ask — can everyone confirm by EOD? otherwise we go live Tue 09:00 PT. Thanks! :rocket:
